react_result.final_narrative_text: The differentially abundant metabolites converge overwhelmingly on arachidonic acid metabolism and its downstream eicosanoid pathways. Three independent enrichment paradigms—multi-database ORA (RaMP), m/z-direct network activity (Mummichog), and KEGG-specific pathway-set enrichment (MetaboAnalystR)—all rank arachidonate-derived lipid mediators as the top hit. In the RaMP ORA the WikiPathways entry 'Eicosanoid synthesis' (WP:WP167) achieves FDR 1.39×10⁻¹² with a fold-enrichment of 1251, driven by five lipid analytes: 5(S)-HETE, 15(S)-HETE, 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J₂, arachidonic acid, and leukotriene A₄. The Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently recovers 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' as its single most significant pathway (p = 0.006) with all five lipids overlapping, and MetaboAnalystR confirms the equivalent KEGG term (hsa00590) as the top-ranked KEGG pathway. The five driver lipids span three enzymatic branches of the pathway: the 5-lipoxygenase branch (5-HETE, LTA4), the 15-lipoxygenase branch (15-HETE), and the cyclooxygenase/prostaglandin branch (15-deoxy-PGJ₂). Arachidonic acid itself serves as the common substrate upstream of all three branches. L-Serine contributes weakly to glycerophospholipid metabolism (Mummichog rank 2) but is a peripheral hit. Methylmalonic acid, dehydroascorbic acid, and 6-methylthiopurine are not assigned to the eicosanoid axis by any tool, suggesting they reflect independent perturbation branches not captured by the core lipid signal.

react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent enrichment paradigms (multi-database ORA via RaMP, m/z-direct network activity via Mummichog, and KEGG-specific pathway-set enrichment via MetaboAnalystR) converge on the eicosanoid axis as the dominant biological signal. RaMP ORA ranks WP:WP167 (Eicosanoid synthesis) as the top hit at FDR = 1.39×10⁻¹² with a fold enrichment of 1251, driven by five lipid analytes: 5(S)-HETE, 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J₂, 15(S)-HETE, arachidonic acid, and leukotriene A₄. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis independently recovers MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism at p = 0.0055 (rank 0, 11 matched metabolites). MetaboAnalystR confirms KEGG:hsa00590 as the top-ranked KEGG pathway (rank 0), driven by four of the same lipid analytes (arachidonic acid, leukotriene A₄, 15(S)-HETE, 5(S)-HETE). Mummichog additionally reports Glycerophospholipid metabolism (MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism, rank 1, p = 0.0197) and Prostaglandin formation from arachidonate (MUMM:prostaglandin_formation_from_arachidonate, rank 3, p = 0.0367), each incorporating overlapping lipid sets from the input. L-Serine contributes to Glycerophospholipid metabolism (Mummichog) and to Glycine, serine, alanine and threonine metabolism (Mummichog, rank 11). Methylmalonic acid, dehydroascorbic acid, and 6-methylthiopurine are not captured by the eicosanoid axis in any tool.
